scope: Exact arithmetic and symbolic checks, not measured laptop performance
assumptions: m,n,w real; R is the ordinary 2D rotation matrix
interpretation: Relative rotation identity does not distinguish a zeta-zero frequency schedule from other fixed schedules. Four FP32 arrays model weights, gradients, and two Adam moments only; implementations can differ. Weight-only storage excludes activations, scale tables, metadata, memory logs and indexes. Throughputs are illustrative assumptions.
